# Objective

Implement G9A1 durable identity and persistence substrate on
`feature/g9a1-spatial-identity-persistence-foundation` without spatial solving.

**AUTHORIZED CANONICAL PROMPT — NOT STARTED / UNEXECUTED.**

# Mandatory entry gate

Require final G9P author approval, author-approved spatial specification,
Accepted ADRs 0010/0011, clean approved baseline, exact prompt hash, and green
G6-G8 plus composed authority. G9O1 PASS is not a semantic entry condition.
Author closeout authorized G9A1 after G9O1 PASS, but this file does not execute
it; an explicit canonical task invocation is still required.

# Hard dependencies

The approved durable-identity/projection-system persistence contracts and
frozen G8 authority are hard inputs. No G9 semantic implementation phase and no
frontend completion is required before A1.

# Recommended execution predecessor

Run G9O1 first for reproducible context and guides, while recording that its
PASS is operational advice rather than an A1 semantic dependency.

# Global/release gate

A1 evidence feeds G9A and global G9 closeout; A1 PASS alone authorizes neither
A2 nor any public surface without the next explicit author gate.

# Authority and evidence hierarchy

Read current GeoElement/Construction/XML/copy/undo/redefine code and tests first,
then `AGENTS.md`, approved spatial contracts and G9P evidence.

# Scope

Add construction-scoped durable typed IDs and registry seams for participating
geos, spatial objects, projection frames, projection systems, diagram maps,
frame relations and bindings; versioned XML; deterministic allocation/collision
handling; copy remapping; undo/reopen restoration; and the explicit
compatible-redefine transaction seam. No projection geometry is evaluated.

# Explicitly forbidden scope

No spatial reconstruction, projection binding behavior, 3D authority, public
Locus changes, GUI, DXF, label/proximity identity, or migration inference.

# Editable boundaries

Minimum shared Construction/GeoElement/XML/copy seams, additive GeoCeDG identity
packages, tests, specs/ADR status, upstream inventory, verifier and evidence.

# Productive versus test-private permissions

Only the approved reusable identity substrate is productive. Test fixtures may
exercise future-shaped IDs but cannot publish spatial semantics.

# Architectural placement

Identity that must survive save/copy/undo belongs in the shared document/kernel
model; registries are construction-scoped and not global frontend state.

# Required design/specification

Do not repurpose `ceID`. Implement allocation, reference integrity, projection-
system relation skeletons, copy closure, collision and serialization rules.
Propagate an explicit old-target transaction token through every host redefine
route. Preserve ID only after the approved provider/type/schema/role/cardinality
compatibility predicate; label or host `GeoClass` compatibility is insufficient.

# Geometric invariants and degeneracies

Identity is independent of label, coordinate, creation/XML order and revision.
Temporary invalidity never causes identity reassignment.

# Compatibility and serialization

Old files load without IDs/associations and acquire no inferred spatial meaning.
New XML is versioned; copy allocates/remaps as specified; undo/reopen restores.

# Required tests and commands

Cover rename, copy/paste, undo/redo, reopen, recompute, compatible redefine,
true/incompatible replacement, delete/recreate, projection-system/map/relation
closures, collisions, malformed XML and deterministic rerun. Run focused G9A1
and composed verification without `-SkipBuild`.

# Required artifacts

Source/tests, XML fixtures, updated normative records, upstream impact, focused
verifier, evidence and report.

# Stop conditions

Stop if IDs depend on labels/order, copy cannot remap atomically, old files gain
inferred bindings, redefine continuity cannot be anchored to the explicit old
ID and approved predicate, or shared persistence requires a broader unapproved
rewrite.
